notes:
## Important upgrade notice

v0.3.1 stays on the v3 data contract introduced in v0.3.0. When upgrading from an earlier NomiFun data contract, the app retires/quarantines the previous managed dataset and initializes a clean v3 dataset. Historical local product data is not migrated into v3, and dataset-owned credentials and integrations must be configured again. Arbitrary external user workspaces are not deleted.

## Highlights

- Safely recovers from and retires legacy v3 datasets during startup/bootstrap.
- Aligns the WebUI browser-login request contract and improves embedded shell serving for fast custom-protocol builds.
- Rebuilds the Windows package from the latest main branch after the v0.3.0 cross-platform updater manifest merge.
- Refreshes the Windows x64 updater manifest entry for the v0.3.1 release line.

## Packaging

- This Windows-first release includes the Windows x64 installer and signed Tauri updater assets. macOS and Linux packages can be appended later from their native build machines.
- The Windows installer is not Authenticode-signed. Manual downloads may show a SmartScreen or unknown-publisher warning; Tauri automatic-update signature verification remains enabled.
